note.after_visit_summary:
We think you have a simple bladder infection. This is a common problem and it is treatable. Your urine test showed signs of infection. You have no fever or signs the infection has reached your kidneys.

We are starting a medicine called nitrofurantoin. Take 100 mg by mouth twice a day with food for 5 days. You can keep taking AZO, but only for one more day so it is two days in total. Drink lots of water.

We sent a urine culture to the lab. It takes 2 to 3 days. If it shows a germ that this medicine does not kill, we will call you and give you a different one.

Call us the same day if you get a fever, pain in your back or sides, or vomiting. These could mean the infection is moving to your kidneys. If you do not feel better in 2 to 3 days, let us know. Otherwise you do not need to come back. Bring your cell number and pharmacy address if they change.
